shots.action: Miguel is with his own freshman friend group at a lively university freshman reception. Natural social movement.
shots.camera: vertical handheld medium-wide, slow observational drift
shots.motion: subtle body movement, people crossing naturally
shots.audio: diegetic party ambience, no dialogue from Miguel/Daniel

shots.action: Daniel is with a separate friend group. He notices Miguel across the room.
shots.camera: medium close-up, shallow depth of field, gentle push-in
shots.motion: Daniel turns his eyes toward Miguel, natural blink and breathing

shots.action: Miguel notices Daniel looking at him.
shots.motion: eyes shift, brief eye contact, slight nervous smile

shots.action: Daniel holds the look for a moment and gives a restrained spontaneous smile.
Both remain in the same reception but physically separated by their own groups. They exchange one more glance.
shots.camera: medium-wide vertical composition with strong foreground separation
shots.motion: crowd moves naturally while both remain stable

shots.action: A friend calls Daniel and he turns back toward his group.
shots.camera: over-shoulder from behind Daniel, then slight pan
shots.audio: friend calling Daniel off-camera, natural crowd noise

shots.action: Miguel keeps talking with his group but looks toward Daniel once more.
shots.camera: medium close-up with rack focus from friend group to Miguel
shots.motion: brief glance, then returns attention to group

shots.action: Daniel becomes partially obscured by the crowd as he moves with his friends.
Miguel watches Daniel disappear into the crowd, then turns back. End on his expression.
shots.motion: eyes follow Daniel, tiny smile, cut on expression
